question: Why has Trump invited Putin to Miami while Russia steps up strikes on Ukraine?

lines.text: From Moscow to Miami. Trump has invited Vladimir Putin to the G20 in December.

scene.quote: We've just invited President Putin to the G20
scene.who: Marco Rubio, US Secretary of State

lines.text: It would be his first G20 in person since 2019, and his first trip to the lower 48 states since 2015.
Meanwhile, Russian strikes killed at least 200 Ukrainian civilians in the first 24 days of September.
Today, a strike on a vegetable sorting site in the Kharkiv region killed 7.
Kyiv has had civilian casualties on 16 of the first 24 days of this month.

scene.label: days with civilian casualties in Kyiv
scene.detail: most frequent since the full invasion

lines.text: The Kremlin says no decision has been made yet. So, will he come?

sources.title: Trump invites Putin to Miami for first visit to lower 48 since Obama era
Trump invites Putin to Miami G20: Why that matters
World News in Brief: 'New intensity' to Russian attacks on Ukraine

caption: Trump has invited Putin to the G20 at Doral, Miami on 14-15 December. It would be his first in-person G20 since 2019. The same month, UN monitors counted 200+ civilians killed in Ukraine in 24 days. The Kremlin hasn't decided.
